qG0UNyp69sqlCZM1_AtArQ.zh: 阿根廷內烏肯省(Neuquén Province)今年截至9/3,累計報告2 例確定病例,其中1例死亡。指標個案為26歲男性,出現發燒、肌肉疼痛、呼吸困難等症狀,8/15住院治療,8/18死亡,居住區有嚙齒類動物出沒紀錄;第2例為指標個案之密切接觸者,目前病情穩定。該國已啟動接觸者追蹤及監測,並發佈公共衛生防疫等預防建議。
qG0UNyp69sqlCZM1_AtArQ.en: In Neuquén Province, Argentina, 2 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported this year as of 3 September, one of whom died. The index case was a 26-year-old man who presented with fever, muscle pain and difficulty breathing, was hospitalised on 15 August and died on 18 August; rodent activity had been recorded in his residential area. The second case is a close contact of the index case and is currently stable. The country has initiated contact tracing and surveillance and issued public health prevention recommendations.

F0v-jsSGH5J1Yrq1Gzvg2Q.zh: 阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯省(Buenos Aires)7/12報告6例確定病例,並有45例仍調查中,感染來源疑為自製香腸,當局已加強檢查,並呼籲⺠眾避免食用未經認證的醃製肉類製品。
F0v-jsSGH5J1Yrq1Gzvg2Q.en: Buenos Aires Province, Argentina, reported 6 confirmed cases on 12 July, with 45 cases still under investigation. The suspected source of infection is homemade sausage. Authorities have strengthened inspections and urge the public to avoid eating uncertified cured meat products.

z9lmEAuvz8htAvaanzYfwQ.zh: 荷蘭籍國際郵輪「洪迪亞斯號」發生漢他病毒安地斯型群聚事件,船上共 147 人(86 名乘客及 61 名船員),含括 23 國國籍。截至 5/6 止,WHO 共掌握 8 例郵輪相關病例,其中 3 例死亡,8 例中有 3 例經確認為漢他病毒感染,且其中 2 例基因定序為安地斯病毒。WHO 研判本次群聚發生最可能情境為,指標病例於南美洲南錐體地區(阿根廷、智利等國)旅遊期間經環境暴露感染,於潛伏期內登船,隨後在船上透過與其長時間及密切接觸等,造成人際間傳播。WHO 綜合目前資訊,研判本事件在郵輪整體公共衛生風險為中、全球為低。ECDC 建議將全船人員視為密切接觸者,下船後須進行 6 週隔離與症狀監測。
z9lmEAuvz8htAvaanzYfwQ.en: A Dutch-flagged international cruise ship, the Hondius, has experienced an Andes-type hantavirus cluster. There were 147 people on board (86 passengers and 61 crew) of 23 nationalities. As of 6 May, WHO had identified eight cruise-related cases, three of them fatal. Of the eight cases, three were confirmed as hantavirus infection, and two of these were genome-sequenced as Andes virus. WHO considers the most likely scenario to be that the index case was infected through environmental exposure while travelling in the Southern Cone of South America (such as Argentina and Chile), boarded the ship during the incubation period, and then transmitted the virus to others on board through prolonged close contact. Based on current information, WHO assesses the public health risk on the cruise ship as moderate and the global risk as low. ECDC recommends that all people on board be treated as close contacts and undergo six weeks of quarantine and symptom monitoring after disembarkation.

0XNJobSdgm7bl0H_D43o-Q.zh: WHO更新懸掛荷蘭國旗的郵輪群聚事件,截至5/4累計報告2例確診及5例疑病例,其中3例死亡及1例重症。船上共147名人員(含括23個國籍),4/1從阿根廷出發,發病日介於4/6-28,目前郵輪停靠維德角近海,相關單位已展開後送、撤離及監測等措施。WHO表示過往於歐、亞的致死率(CFR)為 1-15%,而於美洲的致死率可達50%,並評估本事件對大眾風險為低。
0XNJobSdgm7bl0H_D43o-Q.en: WHO has updated information on the cruise ship flying the Dutch flag. As of 4 May, two confirmed cases and five suspected cases had been reported cumulatively, including three deaths and one severe case. There are 147 people on board (of 23 nationalities). The ship departed Argentina on 1 April, and onset dates ranged from 6 to 28 April. The ship is currently anchored off Cape Verde, and relevant authorities have initiated transfers, evacuations and monitoring. WHO states that the CFR historically reported in Europe and Asia is 1–15%, while in the Americas it can reach 50%, and assesses the risk to the public from this event as low.

qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年3/31累計144國/地區報告18萬2,945例確診病例,其中,至少503例死亡。 今年3月共計48國家/地區報告1,235 例新增確診病例,其中5例死亡(CFR 0.4%),70.4%的病例來自非洲地區,相較今年2月,東地中海及西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降,哥倫比亞、丹麥、厄瓜多和新加坡通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/3/9-4/19)共計16國通報969例確診病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、肯亞、蒲隆地為高;非洲以外地區,阿根廷、丹麥、德國、巴基斯坦、葡萄牙、新加坡、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 巴基斯坦信德省通報一起院內群聚事件(前已掌握),傳播原因主要為共用保溫箱、氧氣設備及設備表面受污染。在3至4月期間,該省9縣(/30縣)共29例確診與8例死亡(CFR 28%),死亡個案均為6個月以下嬰兒,基因定序確認為Ib型變異株。
qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 31 March this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 182,945 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 503 died. In March this year, 48 countries and territories reported 1,235 new confirmed cases, including five deaths (CFR 0.4%). 70.4% of cases came from the African region. Compared with February, cases rose in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions and fell in other regions. Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador and Singapore reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African region, over the past six weeks (9 March–19 April), 16 countries reported 969 confirmed cases, including three deaths (CFR 0.3%), with the highest numbers in Madagascar, the DRC, Guinea, Kenya and Burundi. Outside Africa, Argentina, Denmark, Germany, Pakistan, Portugal, Singapore, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to show clade Ib community transmission. Sindh Province in Pakistan reported a hospital cluster (already known), with transmission mainly attributed to shared incubators and oxygen equipment and contaminated equipment surfaces. In March and April, the province's nine of 30 districts recorded 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%). All deaths were in infants under six months, and genetic sequencing confirmed a clade Ib variant.

SHk6ba_1a8WXhng72szpzA.zh: 阿根廷疫情更新,今年迄 4/11 累計報告 5,506 例病例,其中 831 例確診,主要分布於薩爾塔省;美洲地區累計報告病例數以巴西及玻利維亞為多。
SHk6ba_1a8WXhng72szpzA.en: Argentina's outbreak update: as of 11 April this year, 5,506 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 831 confirmed cases, mainly in Salta Province. Across the Americas, Brazil and Bolivia have reported the most cumulative cases.

xrr80roC5ErMIg5Y4gLi1Q.zh: WHO美洲區更新流行病學報告,該區去年共計報告46,870例確定病例,低於2024年同期(66,184例),其中以美國病例數為多,共計報告28,783例確定(含疑)病例,以11-19歲年齡層為多,其次為秘魯(4,632例),另智利(3,387例)、巴西(2,682例)、墨西哥(1,596例)、阿根廷(1,210例)及哥倫比亞(1,178例)亦報告逾千例確定病例。另美國今年截至3/27已報告2,355例確定病例。
xrr80roC5ErMIg5Y4gLi1Q.en: The WHO Americas Region has updated its epidemiological report. The region reported 46,870 confirmed cases last year, lower than the 66,184 reported in the same period of 2024. The United States reported the most, with 28,783 confirmed (including suspected) cases, mainly among people aged 11–19 years. Peru followed with 4,632 cases, and Chile (3,387), Brazil (2,682), Mexico (1,596), Argentina (1,210) and Colombia (1,178) each also reported more than 1,000 confirmed cases. In addition, the United States had reported 2,355 confirmed cases so far this year as of 27 March.

GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年2/28累計144國/地區報告18萬1千餘例確診病例,其中,至少492例死亡。 今年2月共計46國家/地區報告1,184 例新增確診病例,其中4例死亡,58.6%來自非洲地區,相較今年1月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降或持平,阿根廷、奧地利及中非共和國通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/2/1-3/15)共計17國通報907例確診病例,其中7例死亡,以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、肯亞、蒲隆地及賴比瑞亞為高;非洲以外地區,奧地利、比利時、葡萄牙、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。
GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.en: Monthly update: Since 2022 and up to 28 February this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 181,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 492 died. In February this year, 46 countries and regions reported 1,184 new confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; 58.6% came from the African Region. Compared with January this year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined or held steady. Argentina, Austria and the Central African Republic reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (1 February–15 March 2026), 17 countries reported 907 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths; the highest numbers were in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Burundi and Liberia. Outside Africa, Austria, Belgium, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to report clade Ib community transmission.

IbhX00P0GiXta-e5PcGGpA.zh: 美國紐約市於3/13報告首例Clade I境外移入病例,分支型別確診中,病患具歐洲旅遊史,目前隔離中,當局表示無本土傳播情形,評估對民眾風險為低。該國自2024年11月起累計報告12例Clade I病例,因應歐洲Clade Ib疫情上升,當局已加強疾病監測、接觸者追蹤及評估高風險群體之疫苗暴露後預防措施。 阿根廷報告首例Ib本土病例,為首都布宜諾斯艾利斯市31歲男性,病患於2/24出現皮疹、發燒、肌肉/頭痛/肛門直腸痛及淋巴結腫大等症狀。病患自述近期無國外旅遊史,惟於發病前曾與多名旅行者發生性關係。
IbhX00P0GiXta-e5PcGGpA.en: New York City reported the first imported Clade I mpox case in the United States on 13 March; subclade typing is pending. The patient had travelled to Europe and is in isolation. Authorities say there is no local transmission and assess the risk to the public as low. Since November 2024 the United States has reported 12 Clade I cases cumulatively; in response to rising Clade Ib cases in Europe, authorities have strengthened disease surveillance, contact tracing and assessment of post-exposure vaccination for high-risk groups. Argentina reported its first locally acquired Clade Ib case, a 31-year-old man in the capital, Buenos Aires City, who developed rash, fever, muscle and headache pain, anorectal pain and lymphadenopathy from 24 February. The patient reports no recent international travel, but had sexual contact with several travellers before symptom onset.

pyr6ODY6DUzv7jWww4IHKw.zh: 阿根廷疫情更新,本季報告2,217例疑病例,西北部薩爾塔省於今年截至第8週報告36例病例(29例確診),分布於該省不同地區,主要為44-65歲族群。自2025年底以來,美洲地區疫情上升,鄰近之玻利維亞病例數上升,導致阿根廷多地發生境外移入病例,後續亦出現本土傳播病例。
pyr6ODY6DUzv7jWww4IHKw.en: Argentina's epidemic update: this season, 2,217 suspected cases have been reported. In Salta Province in the northwest, 36 cases (29 confirmed) were reported as of week 8 this year, distributed across different parts of the province, mainly in the 44–65 age group. Since late 2025, case numbers in the Americas have risen, and case numbers in neighbouring Bolivia have increased, leading to imported cases in several parts of Argentina, followed by locally acquired cases.

DuXQYMLEKSsPnV-I_cACNA.zh: 阿根廷今年截至2/10累計報告14例病例,病患分布於布宜諾斯艾利斯等4個省份。另自本流行季(2025/7)以來累計報告73例病例,疫情已高於往年;該國2019-2024年致死率(CFR)介於10-32%。
DuXQYMLEKSsPnV-I_cACNA.en: Argentina reported 14 cases so far this year as of 10 February, distributed across four provinces, including Buenos Aires. Since the current epidemic season began in July 2025, 73 cases have been reported cumulatively, which is higher than in previous years. Argentina's case fatality rate (CFR) in 2019–2024 ranged from 10% to 32%.

PHewxGEpiDzV7vKHvVotrA.zh: 阿根廷2025年累計報告86例確定病例,其中28例死亡(CFR:32.5%),該疾病流行期為10月至隔年5月,本流行季累計報告52例,與往年預期病例數相比,已達警戒閾,病患主要分布於中部地區(62%)、其次為西北部地區(29%),病例分佈與宿主分佈相關,另年齡層以20-49歲年齡層為多,當局呼籲民眾加強環境清消、密閉環境須注意通風、控制囓齒動物數量及妥善處理動物屍體等措施,倘出現疑症狀且接觸過囓齒動物,應及時就醫。
PHewxGEpiDzV7vKHvVotrA.en: Argentina reported 86 confirmed cases in 2025, of which 28 died (CFR: 32.5%). The epidemic season runs from October to May of the following year. This season, 52 cases have been reported cumulatively, which has reached the alert threshold compared with expected case numbers in previous years. Most patients are in the central region (62%), followed by the northwest (29%); case distribution is related to host distribution. Most cases are aged 20–49. Authorities urge strengthened environmental disinfection, ventilation of enclosed spaces, control of rodent numbers and proper disposal of animal carcasses. Anyone with suspicious symptoms after contact with rodents should seek medical care promptly.

YEl9FKWMjbU3NSrS4M6iQQ.zh: 阿根廷第25-44週累計報告23例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:39%),其中70%病患分布於中部地區(布宜諾斯艾利斯市、聖大非省及恩特雷里奧斯省),病患主要為20-49歲年齡層。依13例確定病例之流行病學資料,62%具囓齒動物或其分泌物接觸史,46%具農村居住史,31%具鄉村或野外地區旅遊史,目前尚未發發現人傳人病例。常見症狀包括發燒 (95%)、肌肉痛 (71%)、頭痛、嘔吐及關節痛等;當局表示9月至4月為高風險季節,建議將漢他病毒病納入急性發燒之鑑別診斷之一,另請民眾避免接觸囓齒動物及其分泌物,並落實戶外活動之防疫措施。
YEl9FKWMjbU3NSrS4M6iQQ.en: Argentina reported 23 confirmed cases cumulatively in weeks 25–44, of which 9 died (CFR: 39%). 70% of cases were in the central region (Buenos Aires city, Santa Fe province and Entre Ríos province), and most patients were aged 20–49. Based on epidemiological data for 13 confirmed cases, 62% had contact with rodents or their secretions, 46% had lived in rural areas, and 31% had travelled to rural or wild areas. No person-to-person transmission has been found. Common symptoms include fever (95%), muscle pain (71%), headache, vomiting and joint pain. Authorities say September to April is the high-risk season, and recommend including hantavirus disease in the differential diagnosis of acute fever. They urge people to avoid contact with rodents and their secretions and to take precautions during outdoor activities.

QregOVZ5Cc4WV9dgFxliOg.zh: 阿根廷11/18報告自2025年初截至11/8累計報告36,702例病例,比去年同期(30,445例)增加約20.5%,各區通報率均增加,惟南部地區增幅最大(32%)。該國自2011年病例數穩定上升,於2015年起劇增,2021-22年因新冠肺炎疫情病例數顯著下降,惟仍高於2015年前的病例數,2022年起再次上升,2023年首次全年報告超過3萬例病例,2024年全年報告達36,917例,較2022年(26,647例)增加38.5%。另以20-29歲年齡層的發病率最高,年增率最高之省份為內烏肯省。當局已加強監測並提升檢測能力。
QregOVZ5Cc4WV9dgFxliOg.en: Argentina reported on 18 November that from early 2025 to 8 November, a cumulative 36,702 cases had been reported, about 20.5% higher than the same period last year (30,445 cases). Reporting rates increased in all regions, with the largest increase in the southern region (32%). Cases in the country rose steadily from 2011 and increased sharply from 2015. They fell significantly during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2021–22 but remained higher than before 2015, and have risen again since 2022. In 2023, more than 30,000 cases were reported for the first time in a full year. In 2024, a total of 36,917 cases were reported, a 38.5% increase over 2022 (26,647 cases). The 20–29 age group has the highest incidence, and the province with the highest annual increase is Neuquén. Authorities have strengthened surveillance and improved testing capacity.

CZ_54j-39ke9j7tHt0-p5g.zh: 阿根廷近期疫情上升,今年截至第42週(10/13-19)報告超過3,500例疑病例,其中382例確診及4例死亡,病例數較去年上升3倍,發病率以南部火地省為最高,其次為首都布宜諾斯艾利斯(布市),約41.6%病例為1歲以下兒童。另火地省首府烏蘇懷亞疫情持續,已報告171例,其中66例確診,該地發病率(23.6例)為首都布市(1.6例)的15倍。 日本今年截至10/19累計報告逾8.2萬例,為2018年以來最高,該國自今年4月起持續進行抗藥性細菌分子檢驗,迄今於24間醫療機構35名病患調查結果,顯示超過80%病患檢出抗藥性菌株。
CZ_54j-39ke9j7tHt0-p5g.en: Argentina's outbreak is rising. As of week 42 (13–19 October) this year, more than 3,500 suspected cases had been reported, including 382 confirmed cases and 4 deaths, and case numbers are up threefold from last year. Incidence is highest in the southern province of Tierra del Fuego, followed by the capital, Buenos Aires city. About 41.6% of cases are children under one year old. In addition, the outbreak in Ushuaia, the capital of Tierra del Fuego province, continues: 171 cases have been reported, of which 66 were confirmed, and the incidence there (23.6 cases) is 15 times that of Buenos Aires city (1.6 cases). Japan reported more than 82,000 cases cumulatively as of 19 October this year, the highest since 2018. Since April this year, Japan has continued molecular testing of antimicrobial-resistant bacteria; investigations of 35 patients at 24 medical institutions to date show that more than 80% of patients had resistant strains detected.

VskHcf0AGAl9WIfeUhEZGQ.zh: 阿根廷南部火地島省爆發疫情,該省首府烏蘇懷亞報告135例疑病例及58例確診病例,另有逾700名接觸者,最近1例報告病例為10/3發病,目前已知有3條傳播鏈,多數病例為成年人,目前當局已進行監測及防護措施。另該國今年迄今報告333例確診病例,超過2021-24年同期病例數,主要分布於中部地區。
VskHcf0AGAl9WIfeUhEZGQ.en: An outbreak has occurred in Tierra del Fuego province in southern Argentina. Its provincial capital, Ushuaia, has reported 135 suspected cases and 58 confirmed cases, and more than 700 contacts have been identified. The most recently reported case had onset on 3 October. Three transmission chains are currently known, and most cases are adults. Authorities have implemented surveillance and protective measures. In addition, Argentina has reported 333 confirmed cases so far this year, exceeding the same period in 2021–24, mainly in the central part of the country.

BiUx7TDgA2CoxummqUybnA.zh: WHO於8/29報告阿根廷自5月起爆發多起案例,感染源為受汙染的芬太注射劑(FENTANILO HLB),該藥品常用於疼痛管理;阿根廷當局已於2月禁止藥廠(LABORATORIOS RAMALLO S.A)生產,WHO警告各國,該藥廠於2022年2月後生產的產品存在汙染風險。
BiUx7TDgA2CoxummqUybnA.en: WHO reported on 29 August that Argentina has had multiple outbreak cases since May. The source of infection was contaminated fentanyl injection (FENTANILO HLB), a drug commonly used for pain management. Argentine authorities banned production by the manufacturer LABORATORIOS RAMALLO S.A. in February. WHO warns countries that products made by this manufacturer since February 2022 carry a risk of contamination.

PSHRgOpJYQPk5euoCX5ktw.zh: 阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯省今年截至8/9累計報告16例確定病例,病患均需住院且未接種疫苗,其中1例死亡、1例收治於加護病房,多數病患曾停留於農村及近郊地區,另有108例疑病例檢驗中,當局已加強地方接種疫苗工作。該國去年(2024)報告23例,病例集中於聖古拉斯(San Nicolás)市。
PSHRgOpJYQPk5euoCX5ktw.en: Buenos Aires Province, Argentina, has reported 16 confirmed cases this year as of 9 August. All patients required hospitalization and were unvaccinated. One patient died and one was admitted to intensive care. Most patients had stayed in rural and peri-urban areas. A further 108 suspected cases are awaiting testing, and authorities have intensified local vaccination work. Argentina reported 23 cases last year (2024), concentrated in San Nicolás city.

jR9Nhls1xwIljgdxjXb6cA.zh: 日本今年截至7/27累計報告4例,分別為千葉縣3例及東京都1例,該病原體不存在於該國自然環境,主要發生於前往流行區之旅客,該國2012-23共計報告34例病例,其中33例為境外感染,分別自美國31例(亞利桑那州19例/加州8例)、墨西哥1例、加拉瓜1例,1例為本土病例,其曾接觸過球孢子菌樣本。病例主要以20多歲為主,並以男性為多(男性22例/女性12例);球黴菌症屬該國第四類感染症,病例必須在診斷後立即通報。 美洲之美國西南部、墨西哥北部、中美洲和南美洲部分地區為地方性流行區,除美國外,其他國家未列入正式全國監測或法定通報疾病。墨西哥感染盛行率與美國西南部相近,於2000-19年報告766例,北部乾旱州份(如索諾拉、下加州)為主要流行區;巴西與阿根廷病例逐年增加,甚至擴展至過去之非流行區,巴西於1978-2021年共計報告292例,主要來自東北部巴西皮奧伊州(Piauí )和馬拉昂州(Maranhão)。
jR9Nhls1xwIljgdxjXb6cA.en: Japan has cumulatively reported four cases this year as of 27 July: three in Chiba Prefecture and one in Tokyo Metropolis. The pathogen does not exist in Japan's natural environment, and cases occur mainly in travellers who visit endemic areas. From 2012 to 2023, Japan reported 34 cases in total, 33 of them acquired abroad: 31 from the United States (19 in Arizona and 8 in California), one from Mexico and one from Nicaragua. One case was locally acquired, in a person who had been exposed to Coccidioides specimens. Most cases are in patients in their 20s and are predominantly male (22 men and 12 women). Coccidioidomycosis is a Category IV notifiable infectious disease in Japan, and cases must be reported immediately upon diagnosis. In the Americas, the south-western United States, northern Mexico, Central America and parts of South America are endemic areas. Apart from the United States, other countries do not include the disease in formal national surveillance or statutory notification. Mexico's infection prevalence is similar to that of the south-western United States; Mexico reported 766 cases in 2000–2019, mainly in arid northern states such as Sonora and Baja California. Cases in Brazil and Argentina are increasing year by year and have even spread into previously non-endemic areas. Brazil reported 292 cases in 1978–2021, mainly from the north-eastern Brazilian states of Piauí and Maranhão.

qFKrIM5jBKNq6g1cLIbilA.zh: 阿根廷首都布宜諾斯艾利斯今年截至7月下旬累計報告50例病例,其中2例住院,病患多食用自製或購買之豬肉食品後發病;另2024年同期累計報告76例病例,當局呼籲民眾將豬肉煮熟,避免食用來路不明的肉品。
qFKrIM5jBKNq6g1cLIbilA.en: Buenos Aires, the capital of Argentina, reported 50 cases cumulatively this year as of late July, of which two were hospitalized. Patients mostly became ill after eating homemade or purchased pork products. The same period in 2024 had seen 76 cases cumulatively reported. Authorities urge people to cook pork thoroughly and to avoid eating meat of unknown origin.

TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告約220,000例病例及80例死亡,分布於美/非/亞洲、法屬留旺島及馬約特島,其中,美洲病例數最多,以巴西141,436例及阿根廷2,521例為多,亞洲之印度、斯里蘭卡及巴基斯坦等國報告逾33,000例,非洲塞內加爾亦有報告病例,另法屬留旺島/馬約特島分別報告逾51,000例及560例,ECDC評估歐洲目前環境愈來愈利於病媒蚊活動,當地疾病傳播風險增加。
TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.en: Globally this year, about 220,000 cases and 80 deaths have been reported cumulatively, in the Americas, Africa and Asia, as well as in the French overseas territories of Réunion and Mayotte. The Americas have the most cases, with Brazil reporting 141,436 and Argentina 2,521. Asian countries including India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan have reported more than 33,000 cases. Senegal in Africa has also reported cases. Réunion and Mayotte have reported more than 51,000 and 560 cases, respectively. ECDC assesses that the environment in Europe is increasingly favorable for vector mosquito activity, and the risk of local transmission is increasing.

J3iNpOwwErfMBULdhmEehQ.zh: WHO於4/28公布美洲今年截至4/18疫情概況,共6國報告超過2,300例,其中3例死亡,較去(2024)年同期上升11倍,以加拿大報告1,069例為多,其次為美國(800例,2例死亡)、墨西哥(421例,1例死亡),阿根廷/巴西/貝里斯報告2-21例間。因境外病例持續輸入導致疫情爆發,傳播鏈延長,影響範圍擴大,且美洲區疫苗覆蓋率不佳,僅約30%國家第一劑MMR疫苗覆蓋率超過95%目標,另新冠疫情、疫苗猶豫及醫療保健資源限制,致疫苗覆蓋率偏低,易感人群數上升。WHO評估該地區風險為高。其他區署疫情持續,且因資源限制、及公衛系統薄弱等因素,評估全球風險為中。
J3iNpOwwErfMBULdhmEehQ.en: WHO published on 28 April an overview of the Americas as of 18 April this year: 6 countries reported more than 2,300 cases, including 3 deaths, 11 times the figure for the same period last year. Canada reported the most, with 1,069 cases, followed by the United States (800 cases, 2 deaths) and Mexico (421 cases, 1 death); Argentina, Brazil and Belize reported between 2 and 21 cases each. Continuing imported cases have led to outbreaks, lengthening transmission chains and expanding the affected area. Vaccination coverage in the Americas is poor: only about 30% of countries have first-dose MMR coverage above the 95% target. In addition, the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy and limited healthcare resources have lowered vaccination coverage and increased the number of susceptible people. WHO assesses the risk in the region as high. Outbreaks in other regions continue, and due to resource constraints and weak public health systems, the global risk is assessed as moderate.

WBvuna4xQ0bkW8a3mcIinA.zh: 全球今年截至3月累計14國/地區報告約80,000例病例及46例死亡,分布於美/非/亞洲、法屬留旺島及馬約特島,其中,美洲病例數最多,以巴西71,578例(44例死亡)及阿根廷1,550例為多,亞洲巴基斯坦報告393例,非洲塞內加爾報告2例,另法屬留旺島報告逾13,000例(2例死亡),法屬馬約特島報告1例,ECDC評估歐洲目前環境仍不利於病媒蚊活動,每年疫情多發生於6 -11月。
WBvuna4xQ0bkW8a3mcIinA.en: As of March this year, 14 countries and regions globally have reported about 80,000 cases and 46 deaths cumulatively, distributed across the Americas, Africa and Asia, as well as Réunion and Mayotte (France). The Americas have the most cases, led by Brazil with 71,578 cases (44 deaths) and Argentina with 1,550. In Asia, Pakistan reported 393 cases; in Africa, Senegal reported 2 cases. Réunion (France) reported more than 13,000 cases (2 deaths), and Mayotte (France) reported 1 case. The ECDC assesses that the environment in Europe is still unfavourable for vector mosquito activity, and outbreaks in Europe each year mostly occur from June to November.

4Q183reyS9hKIG-2GodRvA.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告7,300餘例病例,主要分布於巴西、阿根廷、玻利維亞等國;去年該洲累計報告逾4萬例病例,病例數以巴西為最多。
4Q183reyS9hKIG-2GodRvA.en: Americas update: so far this year, more than 7,300 cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in Brazil, Argentina and Bolivia. Last year the region reported more than 40,000 cases cumulatively, with Brazil having the most.

HdrWXnQWqWHhzEIY-LnE6Q.zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,最近1天內報告8例病例住院治療,今年迄今已累計2,052例病例及14例死亡,去年累計101,214例病例及575例死亡。 阿根廷疫情更新,自去年第31週至今年第11週累計42,800餘例疑病例及2,800餘例確診病例,以中部地區為多,其中97.5%病例無旅遊史,4例病例與器官移植相關,主要流行型別為DEN-1,其次為DEN-2。
HdrWXnQWqWHhzEIY-LnE6Q.en: Bangladesh update: 8 cases were reported and hospitalized within the most recent day. So far this year, 2,052 cases and 14 deaths have been reported cumulatively; last year there were 101,214 cases and 575 deaths. Argentina update: from week 31 of last year to week 11 of this year, more than 42,800 suspected cases and more than 2,800 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in the central region. Of these, 97.5% had no travel history, and 4 cases were related to organ transplantation. The main circulating serotype is DEN-1, followed by DEN-2.

mbqyo_nGNRdMAcj542Syxg.zh: 越南3/21公布今年迄今共63省市報告4.2萬餘例疑病例,其中逾4,000例確診及5例死亡,以南部(54%)為多,次為中部(20%),多數病例為9個月至15歲以下孩童,占比超過70%,其中超過95%未接種疫苗。目前病例集中於都會地區,惟山區省分病例數呈增加趨勢,目前預期疫情將下降,惟全國各地仍將持續發生病例,尤其是山區及疫苗覆蓋率低之省分。 美國中南部疫情持續,截至3/25累計報告379例(德州327例/新墨西哥州43例/奧克拉荷馬州9例),其中42例住院,2例死亡,該國公布今年截至3/20已有18州報告378例,其中64例住院。 PAHO於3/24發布美洲地區風險評估,截至3/15共4國報告507例,分別為美國301例(含2例死亡)、加拿大173例、墨西哥22例及阿根廷11例,病例數較去年同期91例上升5.5倍。因病毒於該區持續流行,多數國家疫苗覆蓋率未達95%目標,且新冠疫情期間疫苗接種中斷,疫苗猶豫情形增加及弱勢族群醫療可近性有限等因素,評估整體風險為高,評估信心水準為高。 吉爾吉斯今年迄今報告4,055例,其中,8例兒童死亡,首都比斯凱克、北部楚河州與南部奧什州病例數大幅上升,超過95%病例未接種疫苗;該國去年報告1.4萬餘例及6例死亡,疫情上升主要為疫苗覆蓋率低所致,比斯凱克覆蓋率僅63%。
mbqyo_nGNRdMAcj542Syxg.en: Viet Nam announced on 21 March that 63 provinces and cities have reported over 42,000 suspected cases so far this year, of which over 4,000 are confirmed, with 5 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the south (54%), followed by the central region (20%). Most cases are children aged from 9 months to under 15 years, accounting for over 70%, and over 95% were unvaccinated. Cases are currently concentrated in urban areas, but numbers are rising in mountainous provinces. Although the outbreak is expected to decline, cases will continue to occur across the country, especially in mountainous areas and provinces with low vaccination coverage. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 25 March, 379 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 327, New Mexico 43, Oklahoma 9), of which 42 were hospitalized and 2 died. The United States reported that as of 20 March, 378 cases had been reported from 18 states, of which 64 were hospitalized. PAHO issued a risk assessment for the Americas on 24 March. As of 15 March, 4 countries had reported 507 cases: the United States 301 (including 2 deaths), Canada 173, Mexico 22 and Argentina 11. This is 5.5 times the 91 cases reported in the same period last year. Because the virus continues to circulate in the region, most countries have not reached the 95% vaccination coverage target, vaccination was disrupted during the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy has increased and access to healthcare for vulnerable groups is limited, the overall risk is assessed as high, with high confidence. Kyrgyzstan has reported 4,055 cases so far this year, including 8 child deaths. Case numbers have risen sharply in the capital Bishkek, northern Chuy Region and southern Osh Region, and over 95% of cases were unvaccinated. Kyrgyzstan reported over 14,000 cases and 6 deaths last year. The increase is mainly due to low vaccination coverage; coverage in Bishkek is only 63%.

OumBe4A1sdGAHicpNvYQSQ.zh: 菲律賓西內羅省疫情上升,今年1-2月累計報告1,151例病例,明顯高於去年同期病例數,主要分布於Bago City 232例。 阿根廷疫情更新,自去年第31週迄今年第5週累計報告28,815例病例,467例確診,其中443例無旅遊史(94.9%),4例病例與器官移植相關,主要流行型別為DEN-1及DEN-2。 東加疫情上升,最近1天新增30例病例,今年迄3/4累計129例病例,無死亡病例,以瓦瓦烏群島63例病例為多。
OumBe4A1sdGAHicpNvYQSQ.en: Dengue is rising in Negros Occidental, Philippines. Cases reported in January and February this year total 1,151, clearly higher than the same period last year, mainly in Bago City with 232 cases. Argentina update: from week 31 of last year to week 5 of this year, 28,815 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 467 were confirmed; of the confirmed cases, 443 (94.9%) had no travel history, and 4 cases were related to organ transplantation. The main circulating serotypes are DEN-1 and DEN-2. Tonga's outbreak is rising: 30 new cases were reported in the last day, and 129 cases have been reported cumulatively to 4 March this year, with no deaths; most are in the Vava'u island group, with 63 cases.

fAAlsbn0jY1NlCkyniZQ7Q.zh: 全球今年截至2/25累計14國報告逾30,000例病例及14例死亡,分布於美洲(11國)、非洲(1國)、亞洲(1國)及歐洲(1國),美洲病例數最多,以巴西31,484例(14例死亡)及阿根廷512例為多,亞洲之巴基斯坦報告201例,非洲之塞內加爾報告2例,另法屬留旺島報告1,631例。
fAAlsbn0jY1NlCkyniZQ7Q.en: As of 25 February this year, 14 countries globally have reported over 30,000 cases and 14 deaths cumulatively, distributed across the Americas (11 countries), Africa (1 country), Asia (1 country) and Europe (1 country). The Americas have the most cases, mainly Brazil with 31,484 cases (14 deaths) and Argentina with 512. Pakistan in Asia reported 201 cases, Senegal in Africa reported 2 cases, and French Réunion reported 1,631 cases.

JRj0JYSEysFGKKVcb3SVYg.zh: 阿根廷疫情更新,今年截至2/27累計報告288例病例,去年全年共報告564例病例;去年美洲地區以巴西、阿根廷、玻利維亞、哥倫比亞等國病例數為多,其中巴西報告42,000餘例病例。
JRj0JYSEysFGKKVcb3SVYg.en: Argentina update: as of 27 February this year, 288 cases have been reported cumulatively, compared with 564 cases for the whole of last year. Last year, case numbers in the Americas were highest in Brazil, Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia and other countries; Brazil reported over 42,000 cases.

r6FgADjZggwIUNilx63u-A.zh: 全球疫情更新,去年截至11月累計逾1,400萬例病例及1萬例死亡,病例主要分布於美洲區報告逾1,250萬例病例及7,000例死亡,以巴西報告逾1,000萬例病例為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、哥倫比亞、巴拉圭。 澳洲疫情更新,該國東北部昆士蘭州湯斯維爾報告1例病例,為該市五年來首例本土病例。
r6FgADjZggwIUNilx63u-A.en: Global update: Last year, up to November, over 14 million cases and 10,000 deaths were reported worldwide. Cases were mainly in the Region of the Americas, which reported over 12.5 million cases and 7,000 deaths, with Brazil reporting over 10 million cases, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Colombia and Paraguay. Australia update: Townsville in Queensland State in the northeast reported one case, the city's first locally acquired case in five years.

1Jl7lMUqXFkPhRfA9aH2Ag.zh: 阿根廷東北部恩特雷里奧斯省(Entre Rios)報告20例病例,當局提醒民眾應減少或避免接觸禽鳥等預防措施,以降低感染風險。
1Jl7lMUqXFkPhRfA9aH2Ag.en: In Entre Ríos Province in northeastern Argentina, 20 cases have been reported. Authorities remind the public to reduce or avoid contact with birds and to take other preventive measures to lower the risk of infection.

unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年迄今累計超過1,300萬例病例及8,500例死亡:  美洲區病例數以巴西為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、巴拉圭、哥倫比亞; 歐洲區法國、義大利、西班牙有報告病例; 東地中海區伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦有報告病例; 東南亞區孟加拉及泊爾病例數上升,印度喀拉拉邦及卡納塔卡邦今年病例數高於去年同期,印病例數下降; 西太平洋區中國及越南病例數上升,柬埔寨病例數下降; 非洲區中非共和國於9月中公布爆發疫情,多哥疫情亦上升。
unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.

Ww_azonsycr40aEYFA9nRQ.zh: 美國今年疫情較往年為高,截至10/10累計32州報告267例病例,近期有緩和趨勢,病患中41%為5歲以下兒童,88%未接種疫苗或接種史不明,約40%住院,分布以伊利諾州、明蘇達州及奧勒岡州為多。 阿根廷中部內羅河省10/4爆發群聚感染事件,累計報告10例疑病例,其中3例已確診,確診者均為兒童且無疫苗接種史,研判與境外移入病例有關。
Ww_azonsycr40aEYFA9nRQ.en: US cases this year are higher than in previous years. As of 10 October, 267 cases had been reported cumulatively from 32 states, with a recent easing trend. Of the patients, 41% were children under 5 years old, 88% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and about 40% were hospitalized. Cases are concentrated in Illinois, Minnesota and Oregon. In Entre Ríos province in central Argentina, a cluster outbreak occurred on 4 October; 10 suspected cases were reported cumulatively, of which 3 have been confirmed. All confirmed cases were children with no vaccination history, and the outbreak is assessed to be related to an imported case from abroad.
